remarks: Bright, welcoming, and move-in ready, this two-level townhome in the Highview East community offers a comfortable layout with several key updates, including new flooring throughout and a new HVAC system and hot water heater (2022). The main level features a spacious living room that flows into the dining area, where sliders lead to a pleasant private outdoor space. Upstairs, you'll find two generously sized bedrooms, convenient upper-level laundry, and a pull-down attic for added storage. Residents also enjoy a well-maintained in-ground pool for summer months. Ideally located near I-95, Route 7, the Merritt Parkway, the SoNo Collection, restaurants, the train, and the hospital. Professional photos will be posted Saturday.
